gloss_en: The impossibility of humanly comprehending or grasping with our intellect God's conduct/governance of the world (hanhagato yitbarakh), owing to His exaltedness beyond our understanding — the principle in LM II:52 that questions against God are therefore fitting and inevitable
canonical_he: אי אפשר שנבין ונשיג בשכלנו הנהגתו יתברך
